Original source retained in classic-super-mario/. package.json declares ISC; upstream has no standalone LICENSE file. Nintendo character/media assets have no separate grant established here. This is a local prototype dependency, not a claim of commercial redistribution rights.
Runtime adaptation in apps/web/public/mario/: relative local URLs, parent-scoped controller, simultaneous held keys, no keyup throttling, removed drag-to-teleport debug controls, pause, fall reset, disconnect watchdog and responsive canvas, camera follow and bounded frame catch-up. Original source remains unchanged.
